paragraphs.text: People tend to want as many choices as possible. They believe this will maximize their 26 of making the best decision. But research shows that, when it comes to actually making a 27 from all of these choices, people can become 28 and avoid making a decision altogether. Even worse, when people finally do decide, they are generally less satisfied with their decision and feel more regretful over whatever choice they made.

sentences.text: People tend to want as many choices as possible.

analysis.translationLiteral: 人们倾向于想要尽可能多的选择。
analysis.translationNatural: 人总想要尽可能多的选项。
analysis.structMarkup: 【People】 _tend to want_ ~as many choices as possible~.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓宾（含 as...as possible 比较结构）

components.note: 复数主语，谓语用 tend 的原形
tend to do 表示「往往、倾向于」，to want 是不定式作补语
as...as possible 表「尽可能……」，choices 是 want 的宾语

clauses: 本句是简单句，没有从句；主干为「主谓宾（含 as...as possible 比较结构）」。

phrases.meaning: 往往会、倾向于
phrases.usage: 后接动词原形，表示一般性倾向。
phrases.example: People tend to overestimate risk. 人们往往高估风险。

phrases.meaning: 人们（复数集合名词，谓语用复数）；民族（可数）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：people（人们，复数）/ person（一个人）/ peoples（多个民族）。常见搭配：young people / people in business。
phrases.example: Most people agree on this point. 多数人同意这一点。

phrases.meaning: 倾向于、往往会（tend to do）；照料（tend to sb）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：tend to do（倾向于）/ tend to sb（照料某人）。常见搭配：tend to do / tend to be。
phrases.example: Men tend to exhibit more of these behaviors. 男性往往表现出更多这类行为。

pitfalls: tend to 后接动词原形，不接动名词。
注意区分：people（人们，复数）/ person（一个人）/ peoples（多个民族）。
注意区分：tend to do（倾向于）/ tend to sb（照料某人）。
analysis.paragraphRole: 首段抛出核心矛盾：人们想要尽可能多的选择，但研究证明选项越多反而越让人困惑、逃避决定且更后悔。

sentences.text: They believe this will maximize their 26 of making the best decision.

analysis.translationLiteral: 他们相信这会最大化他们做出最佳决策的 26。
analysis.translationNatural: 他们觉得，这样能让自己做出最佳决定的 26 最大化。
analysis.structMarkup: 【They】 _believe_ {this will maximize their 26 of making the best decision}.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓 + 宾语从句（that 省略，内含 of 介词短语）

components.note: 指代上一句的人们
后接 that 省略的从句说明相信的内容

components.part: this will maximize their 26 of making the best decision
components.note: 省略 that，从句主语 this，谓语 will maximize，of making... 作后置定语

clauses: 宾语从句「this will maximize their 26 of making the best decision」：省略 that，从句主语 this，谓语 will maximize，of making... 作后置定语
本句主干为「主谓 + 宾语从句（that 省略，内含 of 介词短语）」，先找限定动词再切分修饰成分。

phrases.meaning: 相信、认为
phrases.usage: 常见搭配：believe in / believe that。
phrases.example: I believe he is right. 我认为他是对的。

phrases.meaning: 做、制造；使得；获得、挣得（本文按语境取义）（make 的现在分词/动名词形式）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：making（现在分词/动名词）/ make（原形）。
phrases.example: They believe this will maximize their 26 of making the best decision. 他们觉得，这样能让自己做出最佳决定的 26 最大化。

phrases.meaning: 决定、抉择
phrases.usage: 注意区分：make / take / reach a decision（做决定，用 make/take，不说 do a decision）/ decision to do（用不定式，不用 of doing）/ decisive（决定性的，形容词）。常见搭配：make a decision / reach a decision。
phrases.example: We made a decision quickly. 我们很快做了决定。

pitfalls: 注意区分：making（现在分词/动名词）/ make（原形）。
注意区分：make / take / reach a decision（做决定，用 make/take，不说 do a decision）/ decision to do（用不定式，不用 of doing）/ decisive（决定性的，形容词）。
analysis.paragraphRole: 解释人们偏爱多选项的心理：以为更多选择能放大选对的概率，为后文反转铺垫。

sentences.text: But research shows that, when it comes to actually making a 27 from all of these choices, people can become 28 and avoid making a decision altogether.

analysis.translationLiteral: 但研究表明，当真正要从所有这些选择中做出一个 27 时，人们会变得 28，并完全避免做决定。
analysis.translationNatural: 但研究指出，当真要从一堆选项里挑一个 27 时，人就会变得 28，索性不做决定了。
analysis.structMarkup: (But) 【research】 _shows_ {that, when it comes to actually making a 27 from all of these choices, people can become 28 and avoid making a decision altogether}.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓 + 宾语从句（that 引导，内含 when 时间状语从句）

components.note: 转折连词，引出与「想要更多选择」相反的研究发现
单数主语，谓语用 shows
后接 that 从句陈述研究结论

components.part: that, when it comes to actually making a 27 from all of these choices, people can become 28 and avoid making a decision altogether
components.note: that 引导，从句内嵌 when it comes to... 时间状语，people 是从句主语

clauses: 宾语从句「that, when it comes to actually making a 27 from all of these choices,」：that 引导，从句内嵌 when it comes to... 时间状语，people 是从句主语
that 引导宾语从句，作前面动词的宾语，从句用陈述语序。

phrases.meaning: 说到、涉及
phrases.usage: to 是介词，后接名词或动名词。
phrases.example: When it comes to money, be careful. 说到钱要谨慎。

phrases.meaning: 研究（不可数）；调查 / 研究
phrases.usage: 注意区分：research（不可数）/ study（可数，一项研究）/ researches（罕用）。常见搭配：a body of research / research on sth。
phrases.example: A growing body of research supports this. 越来越多的研究支持这一点。

phrases.meaning: come 的第三人称单数（来）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：comes（三单）/ come（原形）。常见搭配：comes from / comes with。
phrases.example: With success comes new pressure. 成功带来新的压力。

pitfalls: when it comes to 后接动名词，不接原形。
宾语从句用陈述语序，不要把助动词提到主语前。
analysis.paragraphRole: 用研究结论反转前文：面对过多选项，人会陷入困惑并干脆不做决定。

sentences.text: Even worse, when people finally do decide, they are generally less satisfied with their decision and feel more regretful over whatever choice they made.

analysis.translationLiteral: 更糟的是，当人们最终确实做了决定，他们通常对自己的决定更不满意，并对他们所做的任何选择感到更后悔。
analysis.translationNatural: 更糟的是，等人们终于下定决心，往往反而更不待见自己的决定，对选了啥也更后悔。
analysis.structMarkup: (Even worse,) {when people finally do decide}, 【they】 _are generally less satisfied with their decision and feel more regretful over whatever choice they made_.
analysis.structureSummary: 时间状语从句 + 主谓（并列：系表 + 谓语）

components.note: 评注性状语，引出递进的负面结果
when 引导时间从句，do 表强调
指代 people

components.part: are generally less satisfied with their decision and feel more regretful over whatever choice they made
components.note: 并列谓语，前半为系表（less satisfied），后半 feel 接形容词 regretful

clauses: 状语从句「when people finally do decide」：when 引导时间从句，do 表强调
关系词引导定语从句，修饰前面的先行词；从句内部用陈述语序。

phrases.meaning: 人们（复数集合名词，谓语用复数）；民族（可数）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：people（人们，复数）/ person（一个人）/ peoples（多个民族）。常见搭配：young people / people in business。
phrases.example: Most people agree on this point. 多数人同意这一点。

phrases.meaning: 最后、终于（强调次序或结果）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：finally（最后）/ eventually（最终，强调结果）/ at last（终于）。常见搭配：finally, ... / finally arrived。
phrases.example: The law was finally passed. 法律终于通过。

phrases.meaning: 通常、一般地；普遍地
phrases.usage: 注意区分：generally（通常）/ in general（总的来说）/ general（总体的）。常见搭配：generally speaking / generally accepted。
phrases.example: General management generally helps. 总体管理通常有帮助。

pitfalls: 定语从句中关系词已充当成分，从句里不要再重复该代词。
注意区分：people（人们，复数）/ person（一个人）/ peoples（多个民族）。
注意区分：finally（最后）/ eventually（最终，强调结果）/ at last（终于）。
analysis.paragraphRole: 进一步指出即便做了决定，满意度也更低、后悔更强，凸显选择过载的代价。

paragraphs.text: Why does this happen? Research shows that when people choose from many options, they 29 more in the decision, but feel less confident in their ability to decide well. In other words, when we are 30 with more choices, making the "right" or "correct" decision begins to feel more 31 and, at the same time, more difficult to do. This may contribute to the deep fear that we will make the wrong decision.

analysis.translationLiteral: 为什么会发生这种情况？
analysis.structureSummary: 特殊疑问句（疑问副词 Why 提前，助动词 does）

components.note: 疑问副词，提问原因，置于句首
指代上文现象
does 助动词与 happen 构成疑问谓语，主语 this 插入其中

clauses: 本句为疑问句；一般疑问句把助动词/系动词提前，特殊疑问句用疑问词开头。
本句主干为「特殊疑问句（疑问副词 Why 提前，助动词 does）」，先找限定动词再切分修饰成分。

phrases.meaning: 发生（不及物）；碰巧（happen to do）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：happen to sb（发生在某人身上）/ happen to do（碰巧）/ take place（发生，正式）。常见搭配：happen to / what happened。
phrases.example: Could the same thing happen to crops? 同样的事会发生在农作物上吗？

pitfalls: 疑问句中的宾语从句仍用陈述语序，不能倒装。
注意区分：happen to sb（发生在某人身上）/ happen to do（碰巧）/ take place（发生，正式）。
analysis.paragraphRole: 用设问引出第二段：探究为何更多选择反而带来更糟结果。

sentences.text: Research shows that when people choose from many options, they 29 more in the decision, but feel less confident in their ability to decide well.

analysis.translationNatural: 研究显示，当面对一堆选项，人会在做决定上 29 更多，却对「能不能选好」更没把握。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Research】 _shows_ {that when people choose from many options, they 29 more in the decision, but feel less confident in their ability to decide well}.

phrases.meaning: 研究（不可数）；调查 / 研究
phrases.usage: 注意区分：research（不可数）/ study（可数，一项研究）/ researches（罕用）。常见搭配：a body of research / research on sth。
phrases.example: A growing body of research supports this. 越来越多的研究支持这一点。

phrases.meaning: 人们（复数集合名词，谓语用复数）；民族（可数）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：people（人们，复数）/ person（一个人）/ peoples（多个民族）。常见搭配：young people / people in business。

analysis.paragraphRole: 给出原因一：选项多使人投入更多却信心更弱，解释困惑与犹豫的来源。

sentences.text: In other words, when we are 30 with more choices, making the "right" or "correct" decision begins to feel more 31 and, at the same time, more difficult to do.

analysis.translationLiteral: 换句话说，当我们面对更多选择时，做「对」或「正确」的决定开始让人感觉更 31，同时更难做到。
analysis.translationNatural: 换言之，选项越多，做出「正确」决定就变得越 31，也越难下手。

phrases.usage: 换述连接语，后接对前句的重述。

analysis.paragraphRole: 解释原因二：面对更多选项，做「正确」决定显得更重要也更难，加剧选错恐惧。

sentences.text: This may contribute to the deep fear that we will make the wrong decision.

components.part: that we will make the wrong decision

phrases.meaning: 有助于、促成

phrases.meaning: 恐惧、害怕、担忧；畏惧、恐怕、担心
phrases.usage: 注意区分：fear（害怕、恐惧，名词/动词）/ fear of（对…的恐惧，介词 of）/ for fear that/of（唯恐，从句常用 should/might）/ fear to do（不敢做）/ afraid（只作表语，be afraid of，不说 an afraid boy）。
phrases.example: This may contribute to the deep fear that we will make the wrong decision. 这或许会加重我们「会选错」的深层恐惧。

phrases.meaning: 做、制造；使得；获得、挣得（本文按语境取义）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：make（做、制造；使得；获得）/ make sb do（使某人做，不带 to；被动变 be made to do）/ make + 宾语 + 形容词（make it clear）/ make 与 do（do 指做抽象事务，make 指制作/产生）/ make a decision / mistake（用 make 不用 do）。
phrases.example: This may contribute to the deep fear that we will make the wrong decision. 这或许会加重我们「会选错」的深层恐惧。

注意区分：fear（害怕、恐惧，名词/动词）/ fear of（对…的恐惧，介词 of）/ for fear that/of（唯恐，从句常用 should/might）/ fear to do（不敢做）/ afraid（只作表语，be afraid of，不说 an afraid boy）。
analysis.paragraphRole: 收束原因段：上述心理共同催生「怕选错」的深层恐惧。

paragraphs.text: How can we solve this problem? I believe this fear could be tempered by putting decisions into perspective. It might help to remember that many of the choices you make, such as what to have for lunch, will not 32 much in the future and that, even more important choices, like accepting a new job, can 33 be changed. It could also help to 34 these situations with clear guidelines and ideas of what you want from the 35 of options, which can narrow the possible choices, and also make you more confident about your ability to make the right decision.

analysis.paragraphRole: 用设问开启第三段，转向「如何解决选择过载」的对策。

sentences.text: I believe this fear could be tempered by putting decisions into perspective.

analysis.translationLiteral: 我相信这种恐惧可以通过把决定放到正确的视角中而被缓和。
